Programme-level phase, status, mechanism, efficacy, safety, and superiority
conflicts: Registry enrollment is 181 actual. The paper's abstract says 184 enrolled, while its Study results section says 181 entered lead-in and 169 were randomized/treated; 166 formed the full efficacy set and 121 the enriched primary set. The publication discrepancy remains unresolved. The original paper confirms the NCT identifier in its Study design section; no reference is listed in this registry snapshot.

Do not collapse into monotherapy: ongoing oral SSRI/SNRI, placebo lead-in and enriched primary group are essential. Aticaprant is paper context; packet reports NCT linkage in article Study design, rather than registry PMID. Unresolved paper counts: abstract 184 enrolled, 181 in lead-in, 169 randomized/treated, 166 full efficacy, 121 enriched; do not reconcile without source clarification.
